explanations.2: flex makes items line up horizontally and gives us powerful layout tools to control spacing and alignment.
explanations.4: flex-wrap: wrap means if items don't fit on one line, they'll move to the next line instead of shrinking.
explanations.8: var(--ifm-color-emphasis-200) is a CSS variable (think of it like a named color) defined elsewhere that this file uses.
explanations.16: white-space: nowrap prevents the text from breaking into multiple lines; it all stays on one line.
explanations.26: inline-flex is like flex but the container itself only takes up as much width as it needs, rather than full width.
explanations.36: transition defines animations that will smoothly change the three properties below over 0.15 seconds when the element changes state.
